inputs.text: A vertical outdoor digital portrait photograph of one clearly adult woman seated front-facing on pale gray painted metal stairs, her upper body positioned slightly right of center while her raised knees and white-tighted legs dominate the lower half of the frame. Her short dense black hair forms a rounded chin-length bob with softly curved ends and uneven wispy bangs spreading across her forehead and partially framing her eyes. She wears a white short-sleeved sailor-style blouse with a broad folded collar edged by narrow pale blue parallel stripes, a small dark embroidered motif at the center of the collar, and a deep navy ribbon tied loosely at the chest. The blouse is tucked into a dark navy pleated skirt with muted blue side panels and long folded fabric sections draping over the step beside her right hip. Her head tilts slightly toward her right shoulder, the shoulders remain gently rounded forward, and the compact seated posture creates natural compression through the waist, skirt, hips, knees, and ankles. A neatly paired set of dark brown polished leather loafers sits on the lower-left step beside her feet, aligned side by side with their toes facing the camera.
